emg_parsed_json.variant_interpretation:
Splice Region and Splice Polypyrimidine Tract and Intron, Private, Autosomal Dominant, Partial Phenotypic Match   AH - Phenotype match. This gene has been associated with variable developmental delay, congenital hypotonia, epilepsy, short stature, skeletal abnormalities, dysmorphic features and microcephaly in three patients in 5 probands from one paper. The variants identified were missense and 1 splice site variant. This variant is absent in gnomad, internal cases, SpliceAI DS AG 1 and SpliceAI DS AL 0.98.
